description: This Java source file defines the TenantServiceBasedX509Authentication class, which implements device certificate validation against tenant-specific trust anchors using tenant information retrieved from a tenant service. It includes methods for validating X509 certificate chains, retrieving tenant data, and extracting authentication info from certificates.

classes.name: TenantServiceBasedX509Authentication
classes.description: A service class that validates client X.509 certificates against tenant-specific trust anchors, retrieving tenant information from a tenant service and performing chain validation.

methods.name: validateClientCertificate
methods.description: Validates a client certificate chain by retrieving tenant info and trust anchors, then verifying the chain. Returns JSON with subject DN and tenant ID if successful.

methods.name: getTenant
methods.description: Retrieves tenant details from the tenant service based on the issuer DN of the client certificate.

methods.name: getX509CertificatePath
methods.description: Converts an array of Certificates to a list of X509Certificates, failing if any certificate is of unsupported type.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Extracts authentication info (subject DN and tenant ID) from the client certificate path and tenant data.
